method: Exact EIN join between FAC's own 2016+ tribal roster (entity_type=tribal, 6,780 records) and the Census-era FAC archive. NO name matching anywhere in this script.
tier_note: An EIN hit proves the same EIN filed a Single Audit in the earlier year. The tribal typing is FAC's, from the 2016+ row; the Cedar entity link and its tier are INHERITED, not assigned here.
corrects: code/203 printed 'TRIBAL auditee rows = 0' by filtering TYPEOFENTITY on the MODERN vocabulary. The Census-era files use numeric codes, and FY1998 is blank on every row. A wrong-vocabulary filter returns zero and reads as an empty source.
